messages:
Maya Chen: Quick async check-in — need a concise update for Q1 milestones: what shipped, what slipped, and concrete next steps/owners. Goal: one-slide exec summary by EOD Friday.

Arjun Patel: Shipping: model-format-rollout (v2.1) to staging ✅
Slipped: latency-opt work (batching tweaks) — blockers: kernel selector bug on A100 cluster
Owner: Arjun -> fixing kernel selector + QA
ETA: Thu EOD :hourglass:

Priya Singh: From product: confirm we mark model-format-rollout as "shipped: limited" (staged to 20% traffic). Need PM sign-off for full ramp.
Next: finalize rollout checklist, add monitoring alerts for inference tail latency.
Owner: Priya

Tom Alvarez: Code review backlog: 12 PRs blocking latency-opt. Can we prioritize PR#4321 and PR#4334? Both needed to validate autotuner.
If eng-sre can give a quick LGTM we can run a canary.
@Arjun Patel can you rebase PR#4321 today?

Arjun Patel: Yep, rebasing now. Will ping for review when tests pass. Also found a failing unit test in kv-cache evict logic, will debug after rebase.

Jordan Lee: Infra dependency: autoscaler rollout (infra-patch-12) needs one more verification step. If autoscaler isn't live, dedicated pools can't autoscale and may cause capacity constraints for the ramp.
ETA for verification: Wed AM.
Owner: Jordan

deploy-bot: deploy success — model-format-rollout v2.1 -> staging @1764201200 :rocket:

ops-bot: FYI incident #INC-2025-094 impacted embed-service for ~18m this morning. Root cause: transient DB timeout; mitigated and monitoring dashboard updated.
Potential effect: some embeddings for the experimental feature might be missing. Recommend re-run embeddings job after full rollout.

Priya Singh: Thanks @ops-bot — we will hold ramp to 50% until embeddings re-run confirmed. @Maya Chen, for exec slide: can we frame shipped as "staged 20%" and slipped items as "latency opt — in progress (kernel selector)"?

Maya Chen: Yes. Please send one-line bullets by EOD Thu. Format:
- Area — shipped: one-line
- Area — slipped: one-line + owner + ETA
- Blockers: short

Tom Alvarez: Quick ask — reviewers: if you can prioritize PR#4321 and PR#4334 today, drop reactions and I'll nudge in #eng-oncall.

Arjun Patel: PR#4321 -> pushed, test pass. pinging @Tom Alvarez for review :+1:

Jordan Lee: Autoscaler verified in staging at 1764203000, will start smoke tests for dedicated pools.

Maya Chen: Solid. I'll compile slides Friday morning. If anything changes before then, update this thread. Thanks all :pray:
